sights.n: Captain Tsubasa statues, Yotsugi–Tateishi (キャプテン翼 銅像)
sights.address: Yotsugi to Tateishi, Katsushika-ku, Tokyo (trail starts at Keisei Yotsugi Station)
sights.w: Nine bronze statues of Captain Tsubasa characters — Tsubasa, Hyūga, Misaki, Wakabayashi, Roberto — around author Yōichi Takahashi's home turf; the 'Twin Shot' statue lets you step in as Misaki. About 1.5 hours on foot from Yotsugi to Keisei-Tateishi.
sights.anime: Captain Tsubasa — author Yōichi Takahashi's hometown ward honours the football manga with a nine-statue walking trail

sights.n: Seiseki-Sakuragaoka — Whisper of the Heart pilgrimage (聖蹟桜ヶ丘 耳をすませば)
sights.address: Around Seiseki-Sakuragaoka Station (Keiō Line), Tama-shi, Tokyo
sights.w: The real town behind Studio Ghibli's Whisper of the Heart (1995): the station is the film's 'Suginomori', Iroha-zaka climbs to the 'Ghibli rotary', and a 'Seishun no Post' postbox stands by the station; walking maps are handed out locally.
sights.anime: Whisper of the Heart (Studio Ghibli, 1995) — the film's town is drawn from Seiseki-Sakuragaoka; station, slope and rotary are all recognisable
